notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one land card in hand.
Experiment Kraj does not have summoning sickness.
Trench Behemoth and Scaled Herbalist each have at least one +1/+1 counter on them.
description:
Activate Experiment Kraj using Scaled Herbalist's ability by tapping it, putting a land from your hand onto the battlefield.
If the land is mana-producing and enters the battlefield untapped, you may activate it by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Experiment Kraj using Trench Behemoth's ability by returning the land from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Experiment Kraj.
Repeat.
